vehicleSub: Toyota Japan recon luxury edition · Interactive detail model

hotspots.label: Engine
hotspots.title: V6 TFSI Engine Bay
hotspots.description: Move beneath the bonnet to reveal the 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 powerplant, carbon-accented engine cover, and precision cooling architecture.

subHotspots.label: Twin-Scroll Turbo
subHotspots.title: Hot-V Twin-Scroll Turbocharger
subHotspots.description: Mounted inside the 90-degree V of the engine banks for instant spool and immediate torque delivery.

subHotspots.label: Carbon Shroud
subHotspots.title: Carbon Fibre Engine Cover
subHotspots.description: Gloss carbon composite engine dress cover with thermal dampening and Audi V6 TFSI red emblems.

hotspots.label: Interior
hotspots.title: Inside the S5 Avant
hotspots.description: Step into the driver-focused cabin featuring digital instrumentation, S sport steering wheel, ambient lighting, and refined tactile controls.

subHotspots.label: Sport Steering
subHotspots.title: Flat-Bottom Sport Steering Wheel
subHotspots.description: Perforated sport leather wheel with aluminum shift paddles and multifunction drive mode selectors.

subHotspots.label: Virtual Cockpit
subHotspots.title: 12.3-inch Virtual Cockpit HD
subHotspots.description: Configurable instrument screen featuring 3D Google Earth maps and S-specific telemetry views.

subHotspots.label: MMI Display
subHotspots.title: 10.1-inch MMI Touch Display
subHotspots.description: Acoustic and haptic feedback screen running navigation, vehicle dynamics, and wireless Apple CarPlay.

hotspots.label: Boot / Trunk
hotspots.title: Cargo Area & Powered Tailgate
hotspots.description: Open the powered rear tailgate revealing the estate cargo hold with illuminated side liners, luggage tie-downs, and 40:20:40 split-folding rear seats.

subHotspots.label: 40:20:40 Seats
subHotspots.title: 40:20:40 Split-Folding Rear Seats
subHotspots.description: Quick-release levers expand luggage space from 465 litres to 1,495 litres with a flat loading floor.

subHotspots.label: Tailgate Switch
subHotspots.title: Electric Tailgate Close Switch
subHotspots.description: Illuminated tailgate button with programmable opening height memory and lock function.

hotspots.label: Wheel
hotspots.title: Wheel, Brake & Tyre Setup
hotspots.description: Multi-spoke S-design alloy wheels equipped with high-performance ventilated brake discs and red S-branded front multi-piston calipers.

hotspots.label: Dashboard
hotspots.title: Driver Dashboard & Virtual Cockpit
hotspots.description: Driver-oriented curved MMI touch display paired with full digital instrument cluster and configurable navigation views.

hotspots.label: Seats
hotspots.title: S Sport Contoured Seats
hotspots.description: Contoured sport seats upholstered in fine Nappa leather with diamond quilting, embossed S logos and integrated pneumatic side bolstering.

hotspots.label: Bang & Olufsen
hotspots.title: Bang & Olufsen 3D Sound
hotspots.description: Bang & Olufsen 3D Sound System with precision-etched acoustic grilles, 19 speakers, 16-channel amplifier and 755 watts output.

hotspots.label: Rear climate controls
hotspots.title: Rear Cabin Climate Controls
hotspots.description: Dedicated digital temperature panel for rear passengers, regulating dual-zone rear airflow and rear heated seat levels.
